cues: The full list, with each device's layer.
A network card connects a computer.
A modem converts between digital and analogue.
Repeaters and hubs work on raw signals.
Bridges and switches forward by MAC address.
Routers join different networks and choose paths by IP address.
And a gateway translates between different protocols.
